rows.blocker: The term of a non-verified (Not For Federal Identification) Connecticut card issued to somebody not a citizen, such as an F-1 student: no page or law the state publishes gives one. The non-driver ID page says 'valid for 7 years' with no exception; the limited-term REAL ID, whose expiration 'must align with the expiration date on the individual's legal status document(s)' (one year where there's none), is for DACA holders only ('Currently, only residents with Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) status are eligible'); Regs. Conn. State Agencies § 14-137-64a(c) lets the commissioner revoke the card once its holder is 'no longer entitled to be present', and sets no term; CGS chapter 246 has no such provision (searched for 'authorized stay', 'lawful status', 'immigration status', 'visa', 'legal presence', 'citizen'). SLATE keeps the term to the end of lawful presence as its assumption, said so in systems/identity.ts and on the guide's line ('SLATE's reading where the state publishes none'). Also not said by the DMV, and taken by SLATE: whether a non-citizen the DMV doesn't ask back has the twenty days from the first visit (SLATE takes the later, its described return after SAVE); and whose holidays the twenty business days skip (SLATE counts the federal ones). What would settle it: the DMV's answer in writing (its Contact Center, 860-263-5700, or a published policy). Pages tried and not reached: https://digital.ct.gov/dmv/licenses/licenses/non-driver-id-card/non-driver-photo-id---obtaining (2026-10-16: host doesn't resolve, WebFetch ENOTFOUND, the proxy's CONNECT 502); https://eregulations.ct.gov/eRegsPortal/Browse/RCSA/Title_01Subtitle_01-1hSection_01-1h-1/ to -8 and Title_01Subtitle_01-1h/ (2026-10-16: 'Unable to Access Resource (HTTP: 404)'; read instead in the DMV's 2007 compilation, https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/DMV/20/29/mvregspdf.pdf). www.cga.ct.gov was reached only after completing its certificate chain with GoDaddy's G2 intermediate from certs.godaddy.com, the server sending its leaf alone (curl error 60 otherwise; WebFetch 503).
